reason: Both arms are serious games (immersive VR versus web-based platform), so the comparator is also gamified with no conventional control.

reason: Single-group pilot tracking engagement over time with no randomized control comparator (mixed dentistry/nursing).
outcome_primary: Student engagement scores during the activity

reason: Multicentre 1:1 RCT of a serious game plus conventional teaching versus conventional teaching only in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Immediate post-test knowledge score (out of 20, 12-item questionnaire)

meta.note: Reports analysis n=99 vs 98 and a 0.8-1 point (~5%) significant knowledge gain but no group means/SD in the abstract.

reason: Parallel-group RCT of a virtual simulation game versus control for CAUTI prevention in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Post-test knowledge and skill scores on CAUTI prevention

reason: Protocol only with no results, and comparator is generic gamification versus adapted gamification, so both arms are gamified.
outcome_primary: Academic performance (learning gain) - planned, no results

reason: Stratified RCT comparing board-game training and simulation versus interactive lectures in novice nurses and residents.
outcome_primary: Teamwork knowledge and team performance (TeamSTEPPS)

meta.note: Total 124 randomized, 96 completed (24 teams) across 3 arms; reports GEE B=-1.09 p=0.04 for simulation vs control on knowledge, no per-group means/SD/n.

reason: RCT of serious games versus interactive video versus control for parenteral drug administration in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Psychomotor skill performance; perceived stress, satisfaction, self-confidence

meta.note: Three arms (SG=33, VBE=33, Control=33); significant improvement p<0.05 but no group means/SD reported.

reason: Cluster-randomized controlled trial of the Taboo game versus control on nursing students' motivation and perception of nursing diagnoses.
outcome_primary: Learning motivation (IMMS) and perception of nursing diagnoses

reason: Both arms use the Kahoot! game (game-based chatbot + Kahoot! versus Kahoot! with classroom), so the comparator is also gamified.

reason: Parallel-group RCT of game-based VR versus control for postoperative patient admission in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Theoretical knowledge and skill assessment scores

reason: RCT of a gamified infection control program (physical games, escape room) versus lecture-based instruction in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Cognitive achievement, academic self-efficacy, learning motivation

reason: RCT of digital game-based learning versus conventional lecture-based education in surgical nursing students.
outcome_primary: Clinical reasoning and user satisfaction (QUIS)

reason: Assessor-blinded RCT of an interactive digital game versus standard practice for intramuscular injection skills in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Intramuscular injection knowledge and skill scores, exam anxiety, satisfaction

reason: Randomized controlled study of a board game versus case study discussions for elder neglect/abuse knowledge in nursing students.

reason: On-topic virtual hospital game versus standard patient safety education in nursing students, but described as quasi-randomized so randomization not strictly confirmed.

reason: Parallel-group RCT of an escape room simulation versus control for postmortem care training in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Postmortem care knowledge, self-efficacy, motivation

reason: Quasi-experimental with non-equivalent control group and participants non-randomly assigned, so not an RCT.

reason: Described as quasi-experimental but students were randomly assigned to digital game-based guide versus conventional sessions; nursing students with quantitative outcomes.
outcome_primary: Head trauma assessment knowledge and practical skills

reason: RCT of 3D game-based simulation versus traditional instruction for vital signs in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Academic achievement, learning satisfaction, self-confidence

reason: RCT of flipped learning plus escape room gamification versus control for infection control in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Infection control knowledge and self-directed learning skills

reason: RCT of a gamified workshop versus case-based discussion for evidence-based practice competence in clinical nurses.

reason: Nonrandomized, section-allocated quasi-experimental study, so not an RCT.

reason: RCT of an emergency escape room simulation versus traditional education in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Emergency nursing knowledge, anxiety, satisfaction

reason: On-topic quasi-experimental study with nurses randomly assigned to Kahoot! gamification versus lecture; randomization stated but design labeled quasi-experimental.
outcome_primary: Medication knowledge, performance, satisfaction

reason: Parallel RCT of a situational puzzle board game versus reflective writing for death education in nursing students.

reason: Randomized waitlist controlled trial of a home-based serious resuscitation game versus waitlist in nursing students.

reason: Randomized controlled experimental design of patient safety escape rooms versus traditional education in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Patient safety knowledge and team cooperation

reason: Randomized controlled study of gamified teaching material versus lecture/Q&A for aggressive patient management in nursing students.
outcome_primary: Therapeutic communication skills and perception of nursing diagnoses

reason: Intervention study with students randomly divided into Kahoot! gamification versus traditional teaching for vaccination education.
outcome_primary: Vaccination knowledge and satisfaction (also interest, collaboration)
